# Prettier debt baseline — SHRINK-ONLY. Do not add entries.

# These paths were already unformatted BEFORE the H-6 release work and are NOT
# reformatted by it (reformatting frozen change sets is forbidden, and a repo-wide
# reformat would bury review in unrelated churn). Measured at the H-6 baseline
# (commit 0ceb2895dd9a5620d8ef8560bd8c63253562b991): 192 of 329 tracked
# formattable files are unformatted. Provenance of the 192:
#
#   * 189 were created unformatted by the M2..M11 work and never formatted since;
#   *   3 were clean at M1 and became unformatted in commits that are contained in
#       the M5-FROZEN tag (components/ui/icons.tsx via 66f4a0c) or are M2 history
#       (lib/db/migrate.ts, lib/money/index.ts via 38c9bfb) — i.e. frozen history,
#       so they cannot be reformatted as part of this work.
#
# CI rule (.github/workflows/ci.yml, step "Prettier (files changed by this change)"):
#   * a formattable file touched by a change MUST be prettier-clean unless it is
#     listed here; listed files are reported as grandfathered, never hidden;
#   * a file listed here that a change has made clean MUST be removed from this
#     file in that same change — the baseline is enforced shrink-only, so it can
#     never be used to hide new or newly-fixed formatting work.
#
# Paying this debt down is a separate, deliberate task (one path at a time, each
# removal is a real diff); it is not a release-gate prerequisite.
